references.phrase: R-module structure on S via R→S
references.context: Define scalar multiplication r·s=φ(r)s for φ:R→S; the property is evaluated with this specific action.

references.disposition: Transfers the module property to the codomain through restriction of scalars; not a property of S absent a specified ring map.

review_rationale: Read faithfully flat ring maps by restriction of scalars along a unital homomorphism R→S and application of the faithfully flat module criterion to S as an R-module.
